svg.title: Reading Used-Equipment Price Points
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-used-equipment-price-points; chapter number: 2; title: Reading Used-Equipment Price Points; subtitle: Reported auction swings, stalls, and prep spend; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: Dollars as quoted (Steiger figure in Canadian dollars); bars: label: John Deere S780 average, 1-4 yr; min: 317789; max: 346900; typical: 317789; display: $346,900 to $317,789 (-8.4%); label: 8360R stalled bid to hammer; min: 159000; max: 169500; typical: 169500; display: Stalled near $159,000-$160,000; closed $169,500; label: Case IH Steiger 645 Quadtrac sale; min: 710000; max: 710000; typical: 710000; display: 710,000 Canadian at 781 hours; label: Farm Journal tracked model, average to high; min: 15147; max: 36000; typical: 15147; display: $15,147 average; $36,000 high; label: Cab interior refresh spend; min: 7; max: 200; typical: 200; display: $7 rattle can vs. roughly $200 interior kit; caption: Supply drives the read: five-year-old high-horse tractor listings fell 79%, and auctions rose 19.5% while 1-3 year old units sold fell 19.9%.; assumptions note: Each bar is a separate practitioner-reported figure, not a common index. A stalled bid is not a ceiling; documented work orders and warranty history add value buyers pay for.; note: Sources - Machinery Pete, Farm Journal, RealAgriculture, Luke Fritshaw of Ritchie Bros., and Patrick Shivers.
